label: Three comparisons of actuality and capacity in Aristotle Θ.8
paraphrase: Actuality is prior to the corresponding capacity in account and in substance. In time, the seed precedes this mature human, but another actual human, the same in kind and different in number, precedes the seed. More generally, in the generation under discussion, what is potential comes to actuality through something already actual, while the individual’s own capacity can precede its exercise.
